name: Daisuke
source: Daisuke is [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s and [url=https://vndb.org/c8380]Asuka[/url]'s classmate. He is a friendly type of guy that likes to chat with Takuya often at school. He also has a hobby of taking and collecting photos of famous women he is interested in. There's only one girl that he's missing from his collection and that's [url=https://vndb.org/c33936]Ootori Shizuka[/url]. Since it's very hard to get an entry into her high school dormitory, Daisuke will ask of Takuya's [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]female form[/url] to sneak into and take a photo of Shizuka with his camera.
